title.zh: 将布拉干省巴拉格塔斯普隆古巴特描笼涯的Pulonggubat农业中学更名为Pulonggubat国立中学的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of the Pulonggubat Agricultural High School in Barangay Pulonggubat, Balagtas, Bulacan, to Pulonggubat National High School
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of the Pulonggubat Agricultural High School in Barangay Pulonggubat, Balagtas, Bulacan, to Pulonggubat National High School
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Trường trung học phổ thông Pulonggubat Agricultural tại Barangay Pulonggubat, Balagtas, Bulacan thành Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Pulonggubat
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Pulonggubat Agricultural ในบารังไกย์ Pulonggubat, Balagtas, Bulacan เป็นโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Pulonggubat
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah nama Sekolah Menengah Atas Pulonggubat Agricultural di Barangay Pulonggubat, Balagtas, Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Pulonggubat
title.ms: Akta menukar nama Sekolah Menengah Pulonggubat Agricultural di Barangay Pulonggubat, Balagtas, Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Pulonggubat

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1997/ra_8406_1997.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The name of the Pulonggubat Agricultural High School in Barangay Pulonggubat, Municipality of Balagtas, Bulacan, is hereby changed to Pulonggubat National High School.

Any and all provisions in the law creating the Pulonggubat Agricultural High School or its chapter pertaining to the offering of agricultural subjects in its curriculum are hereby repealed to conform with the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
